name: mcp-refresh-doctor
description: Diagnose why a remote MCP server keeps asking users to log in again: runs the OAuth 2.1 token lifecycle (issue, refresh, rotation, reuse, expiry) and judges server-side vs client-side cause.
author: LeeGyeongPil

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=180000 dist-test/test/e2e/*.test.js
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js demo
